Chapter 6533: Cosmic Surge

Chapter 6533: Cosmic Surge

The gate of Life and Death Heaven opened, allowing people to peek inside and see a radiant legion consisting of millions of troops.

They wore divine armors blessed with an immortal dao, resembling a galaxy river capable of sweeping through Heaven World. They had numerous desolate gods and with sheer number, they could kill primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

“Cosmic Surge.” Everyone was amazed to see this legion and uttered its name.

It had been established long ago and withstood the test of time. It was there before the debut of Desolate Ancestor, surviving numerous wars and leaving its marks in history.

The Lord of Life and Death was the founder; its mission was to protect the peace of Three Immortals. Top commanders included Summit Primal Ancestor, Greatbones God, Skynet Demoness, and many more.

A particular woman stood out with the image of a phoenix behind her. Its flame was eternal, granting her everlasting life force and the reborn ability. A similar flame surrounded her but couldn’t hide her beauty.

Her eyes shined like the stars with well-defined brows above, exuding a heroic temperament. She wore a tight-fitting dress instead of armor, making her look agile while showcasing her flawless figure. Her thin waist and round hips were for all to see, accentuated by a string of law used as a belt.

However, her sharp and overwhelming aura drew people’s attention more than her appearance. With the halberd in her grasp, she exuded an oppressive battle spirit like a general ready to charge into the battlefield. Calling her a goddess of war was appropriate.

“Skyfire Phoenix, the grand commander of Cosmic Surge Legion and protector of the lord.” An admirer said.

“She’s personally leading the troops.” Others were shocked to see this.

She had followed the lord for the longest alongside the missing Soaring Phoenix Commander. She acted as the toughest barrier, preventing anyone from getting close to the lord.

“To Corpse Wasteland!” Her command echoed across Heaven World.

Those in Supreme Heaven heaved a sigh of relief, reducing their defense’s area of effect to within their territories. This was a message of their stance to the opponent.

“Corpse Wasteland.” At first, everyone thought it would be a declaration of war against Supreme Heaven.

“The Lord of Life and Death wishes to kill Bao Pu.” Now, the goal became clear to everyone.

Nevertheless, this puzzled them due to the lack of feud between both parties.

“Boom!” The phoenix behind her soared through the air, leaving behind numerous portals.

“March!” She ordered.

The commanders and the troops looked like rivers of stars as they marched toward the portals. This imagery was the reason behind the legion’s name.

“Incredible.” Spectators were impressed with both the legion and Skyfire Phoenix’s ability to open the portals in the blink of an eye.

***

Corpse Wasteland existed in a corner of Uncrossable Expanse. For some reason, this remote region suddenly became the home of corpses. The living was turned into mindless walkers.

Nevertheless, cultivators still traveled there for one thing - life-fuel cicada.

They didn’t know where it came from but it became highly contested. These cicadas could heal life-threatening injuries and prolong life
